ACT III OF 2004
ACT III OF 2004
POLITICAL PARTIES
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 2004
An Act further to
amend the Political Parties Order, 2002
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 31st July, 2004.]
The following Act of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President on 28th July,
2004, is hereby published for -general information:--
It is hereby enacted as
follows:--
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the Political Parties (Amendment)
Act, 2004.
(2) It shall come into force at once
and shall be deemed to have taken effect on and from the 31st December, 2003.
